findings.message: The CRD checlusters.org.eclipse.che under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
ClusterRole/default/che-operator adds rules that the current chart did not have.

The pod template of Deployment/eclipse-che/che-operator changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=che-operator].env[name=CHE_DEFAULT_SPEC_COMPONENTS_OPENVSX_REGISTRY_ENABLED]. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: Stageproof does not read that project's upgrade notes. A skip of more than one minor version, or a new major version, is named here and does not block.
findings.message: Chart version moves from 7.118.0 to 7.125.0, skipping 6 minor versions.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 1 container image changed. Deployment/eclipse-che/che-operator.template.spec.containers[0] che-operator container moves from quay.io/eclipse/che-operator:7.118.0 to quay.io/eclipse/che-operator:7.125.0.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.
Certificate/eclipse-che/che-operator-serving-cert was not judged. the API group is not installed on this server.
Issuer/eclipse-che/che-operator-selfsigned-issuer was not judged. the API group is not installed on this server.
